heading: For Cause
trigger_desc: after written notice, Contractor may terminate or supplement the Work and charge the cost to Subcontractor
verbatim_text: 10.1 **For Cause.** If Subcontractor fails to perform and does not cure within three (3) working days after written notice, Contractor may terminate or supplement the Work and charge the cost to Subcontractor.

heading: Time of Payment
trigger_desc: after Contractor receives payment from Owner for the Work covered by the application
verbatim_text: 3.2 **Time of Payment.** Contractor shall pay Subcontractor the amount approved, less retainage, within **ten (10) days after Contractor receives payment from Owner** for the Work covered by the application.

heading: Notice of Non-Payment
trigger_desc: of the missed due date, delivered by email to Contractor's Project Manager with a copy by certified mail
verbatim_text: 3.3 **Notice of Non-Payment.** If payment is not received when due under Section 3.2, Subcontractor shall give Contractor **written notice of non-payment within ten (10) days of the missed due date**, delivered by email to Contractor's Project Manager with a copy by certified mail. Timely written notice is a **condition precedent** to any claim for payment, interest or suspension of Work arising from the late payment.

4.1 Contractor shall withhold **ten percent (10%)** of each progress payment until the Work is **fifty percent (50%) complete**, and **five percent (5%)** thereafter, provided Subcontractor's performance is satisfactory.

trigger_desc: after Owner's final acceptance of the Project and Subcontractor's delivery of all closeout documents required by Article 9 and a final unconditional lien waiver
verbatim_text: 4.2 Retainage shall be released **thirty (30) days after Owner's final acceptance** of the Project and Subcontractor's delivery of all closeout documents required by Article 9 and a final unconditional lien waiver.

5.1 Subcontractor shall submit all shop drawings, product data and samples **within twenty-one (21) calendar days after Notice to Proceed**. Submittals for **switchgear, switchboards, panelboards and the generator shall be submitted within ten (10) calendar days after Notice to Proceed**.
5.2 Subcontractor shall allow **fourteen (14) calendar days for Architect review** of each submittal.

heading: Delay Notice
trigger_desc: after the start of the event, stating the cause and the estimated impact, delivered by email to Contractor's Project Manager
verbatim_text: 6.2 **Delay Notice.** Subcontractor shall give written notice of any delay **within five (5) calendar days** after the start of the event, stating the cause and the estimated impact, delivered by email to Contractor's Project Manager. Failure to give timely notice waives the claim.

heading: Liquidated Damages
verbatim_text: 6.3 **Liquidated Damages.** If Owner assesses liquidated damages under the Prime Contract, Contractor may pass those damages through to Subcontractor in proportion to Subcontractor's responsibility, at **$1,500 per calendar day**.
7.2 Subcontractor shall submit an itemized price for any requested change **within seven (7) calendar days** of Contractor's request.

heading: Claim Notice
trigger_desc: of the event giving rise to it, delivered by email to Contractor's Project Manager with supporting documentation
verbatim_text: 7.3 **Claim Notice.** Any claim for additional time or money must be submitted in writing **within ten (10) calendar days of the event** giving rise to it, delivered by email to Contractor's Project Manager with supporting documentation. Claims not timely noticed are waived.

heading: Workmanship Warranty
verbatim_text: 8.1 **Workmanship Warranty.** Subcontractor warrants that all Work will be free of defects in materials and workmanship for **one (1) year from the date of Substantial Completion** of the Project, or longer where the Specifications require. Subcontractor shall correct defective Work promptly upon notice at no cost.

9.1 Before final payment, Subcontractor shall deliver: **operation and maintenance (O&M) manuals**, **as-built drawings**, **Owner training** sessions with sign-in sheets, manufacturer warranties for the switchgear, generator and lighting fixtures, test reports and permit/inspection sign-offs.
